title: Softer Trapdoors
description: Changes trapdoor movement sounds to something more quiet, useful for buildstone.
body:
Changes trapdoor sounds to something nicer to listen to when there are more than 2 opening and closing at once. The primary use of this resource pack is intended for buildstone, and this pack aims to make working in close proximity to so many trapdoors more bearable, even pleasant.
[Video example of sounds HERE](https://youtu.be/g7RT9mAHKJE)
